title: excel-inflow-release-rollback-policy/1.0
description: P8.6a — the versioned release-rollback policy. A release rollback is a DECLARED, executable, evidence-preserving procedure: this asset names the trigger conditions, the authorisation required, the target identity you roll back TO, what happens to in-flight runs (the package-pinning rule) and what evidence must be preserved. This file constrains SHAPE only. Cross-vocabulary membership is enforced by scripts/lib/release_journal.mjs at load and never repaired: deployment statuses must be DEPLOYMENT_STATUSES and package modes PACKAGE_MODES (scripts/lib/identity_vocabulary.mjs); the in-flight-run stop path must name an ALREADY REGISTERED reason code in assets/terminal-reason-registry-v1.json; and the clause set, together with which clauses are permanently EXCLUDED_INSTALLED_HOST, is declared in code (ROLLBACK_POLICY_CLAUSE_CONTRACT) so this asset can never quietly claim an installed-host clause is satisfiable.

policy_version.description: Bumping this changes every journal record sealed under it — receipt-visible by construction, because each record carries the policy digest.

scope.description: What this policy can and cannot reach. The installed-host tier is permanently excluded, not deferred.

clauses.description: Keyed by clause_id. The key set must equal ROLLBACK_POLICY_CLAUSE_CONTRACT exactly — no missing clause, no extra clause.

clause_id.description: Stable clause identifier; must equal the entry's key in clauses.

satisfiability.description: portable: satisfiable in this repository with no installed host. EXCLUDED_INSTALLED_HOST: satisfiable ONLY on an installed host, permanently excluded from this programme — declared here rather than pretended satisfiable. The value must equal the code-declared satisfiability for this clause_id.

statement.description: The rule, stated as a rule. Not a description of intent.

procedure_steps.description: Ordered, executable steps. MUST be empty for an EXCLUDED_INSTALLED_HOST clause and non-empty for a portable one.

evidence.description: The artefacts or identities this clause reads or produces. MUST be non-empty for a portable clause.

exclusion_reason.description: Non-null exactly when satisfiability is EXCLUDED_INSTALLED_HOST; must say what host capability is missing.

excluded_from_portable_gate.description: Must equal (satisfiability === "EXCLUDED_INSTALLED_HOST"). An excluded clause is never counted as a portable-gate pass.

binding.description: Machine-readable clause payload. Its required keys per clause_id, and every vocabulary membership inside it, are enforced by scripts/lib/release_journal.mjs — deliberately not duplicated here, following the assets/policy-registry-v1.schema.json precedent.
